biotools.summary: MBC PathNet integrates and visualizes networks of functionally related pathways predicted from transcriptomic and proteomic datasets. The tool utilizes the Molecular Biology of the Cell Ontology and other ontologies to facilitate exploration of shared and distinct mechanisms across datasets.
